learning: In Zig monorepos, cross-tree relative @import from script entrypoints can fail with 'import of file outside module path'; use named module imports wired in build.zig and keep workflows building via those steps.
evidence: Observed failure compiling apps/lift script after importing ../../../libs/core/src/io_helpers.zig directly; fixed by @import("core_io") + build.zig imports.
application: Define shared libs under libs/core and inject per-executable imports (core_io/core_json/core_path) in build graph; avoid direct zig build-exe against files requiring shared modules.

learning: Codified module-boundary guidance for shared Zig imports in monorepo migration docs.
application: Keep future CLI additions on named module imports wired in build.zig to avoid outside-module-path regressions.

learning: For independent CLI release automation in a Zig monorepo, keep a per-app VERSION file and enforce exact tag equality in each workflow before packaging assets.
evidence: zig build build-seq/build-lift/build-cas passed after adding VERSION checks and normalized tar names
application: Use apps/<cli>/VERSION plus <cli>-v<version> tag checks so releases are independently scriptable without cross-CLI coupling.

learning: When exposing custom Zig build steps to Homebrew formulas, make each step depend on install-artifact steps (not compile steps) so expected binaries land in zig-out/bin.
evidence: brew reinstall seq initially failed with ENOENT zig-out/bin/seq after zig build build-seq; fixed by wiring build-seq/build-lift/build-cas to addInstallArtifact steps in skills-zig/build.zig
application: For release and package automation, verify zig build <custom-step> produces install outputs before formula bin.install paths are finalized.

learning: For Homebrew proof of non-local sourcing, formulas must avoid file:// URLs and use remote git/tag URLs; verify via brew info urls.stable.url after reinstall.
evidence: brew info --json=v2 seq/lift/cas now reports url=https://github.com/tkersey/skills-zig.git and grep found no file:// path in active tap formulas
application: Use a post-install proof check that includes formula URL grep + brew info URL fields + Cellar symlink targets when users ask for Homebrew-only sourcing.

learning: For Zig CLI wrappers that delegate to scripts, centralize help-flag detection, script-path resolution, and command launching in libs/core to eliminate drift across apps.
evidence: Added libs/core/src/delegate_helpers.zig and removed duplicated helper blocks from cron/puff/learnings/append_learning wrappers.
zig test libs/core/src/delegate_helpers.zig passed with fuzz + allocation-failure signals; zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast passed.
application: Use core_delegate for future wrapper CLIs and keep wrapper files focused on usage text + error context.

learning: In the skills-zig monorepo, release only apps with actual code diffs, and require per-app build plus --help smoke before tagging and Homebrew tap updates.
evidence: Changed apps discovered by git status: cron, puff, learnings; build/test green via zig test delegate_helpers and zig build build-cron build-puff build-learnings.
application: Map changed apps to Formula/<app>.rb and publish matching tags/releases before brew upgrade/test.

learning: For Homebrew formulas that package multi-binary Zig tools, expose an explicit dispatcher binary (for example cas) when users expect subcommand UX (cas smoke_check), and test both direct and dispatched help paths.
evidence: cas formula installed only cas_instance_runner/cas_smoke_check, so command -v cas was empty despite package being installed; adding cas dispatcher and formula test resolved discoverability.
application: When adding subcommand UX, ship dispatcher in build-cas, include it in bin.install, and verify with brew test plus command -v checks.
